author: Karl Rock
description:
I noticed something interesting while travelling around Sindh, Pakistan: two types of people seem to be allowed to cut the queue… older people and women.

Is this just a Sindh thing, or is it normal across Pakistan? 🤔

I’m curious what people from other parts of Pakistan think. Is this a common cultural norm, or have I just been lucky enough to notice it here?
title: Is this normal in Pakistan?
